pages.text: Two ordinary $(l:companions/combat)Combat Slimes$() share a temporary body through $(l:world/colony_bonding)Colony Bonding$(). The colony combines their health and uses a modest cooperation attack bonus. First deployment and recovery always select Wait.
pages.title: Combat Slime Colony

pages.text: The first member supplies active weapons, shield and armor, including their wear. Both bodies display that armor's material, dye and glint. Member two's original equipment stays stored for unbinding. Each body keeps its own color and held-item appearance.

Damage and healing are shared without creating extra life. Activity alternates, but training and tuning use member one. Recover and unbind to restore the two original UUIDs, gear, cargo, growth and remaining energy. Group target settings begin with the first member's filters.
